scope: Source-derived labeled content coverage, exact visibility alternatives, original canonical effects, conservative whole-read invalidation and exact target lifetime declarations. Conditional model interfaces; not complete native capture or transformation authority.
limitations: A declaration or a well-formed ProviderFactReference does not establish physical source, native coherence, content equality, allocation retirement or capture closure.
Known actual fragment coverage and guarded future ordered coverage are separate. A matching conditional plan is not ready=true and does not grant a backend or permission to free storage.
Original source span HAPPENS_BEFORE does not define a whole work ticket boundary. Unparsed associations remain assumptions; missing paths and budget truncation are unresolved.
The shared query budget bounds derived source, joins, geometry, order and invalidator traversal. Record/FK validation, bounded artifact parsing/replay and detached copying have separate costs.
The OS witness observes a real owned nonblocking pipe short write; only actual byte counts are inserted into a canonical fixture. Automatic native/core/physical-region correspondence is not claimed.
No detector, backend, lowerer, LeWM/GPU profiling or workload speedup is added. R3 and full M0-M2 remain open.
